description: This file defines the ShoppingCartDao interface, specifying methods for access and manipulation of ShoppingCart entities within a shopping cart system, including retrieval by ID, customer, or code, and removal of shopping carts.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDao
classes.description: Interface for shopping cart data access objects, extending generic DAO operations and adding shopping cart-specific retrieval and delete methods.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID within the specified MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart associated with a specific Customer.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its unique code within the specified MerchantStore.

methods.name: getShoppingCartById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by ID without collection objects.

methods.name: getShoppingCartByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by code without collection objects.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes a given ShoppingCart from the system.
